## Validation

Record commands, results and any limitations.
For a bug, include the user-facing reproduction before the fix.
For financial changes, include cases where fees, depth or slippage eliminate an apparent edge.
For UI changes, include browser and visual checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] One issue per PR; no unrelated refactors or formatting.
- [ ] Dependencies are merged or explicitly identified as blocking.
- [ ] Financial values remain exact and unsupported assumptions remain visible.
- [ ] Relevant tests and generated contracts are current.
- [ ] Migrations are additive and use the current revision head, if applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private account data, or new execution scope.
